extension.description: Run Apple Intelligence locally as an OpenAI-compatible completion and NES API for VS Code.
command.toggle.title: Apple Intelligence API: Toggle Enable/Disable
command.start.title: Apple Intelligence API: Start Server
command.stop.title: Apple Intelligence API: Stop Server
command.restart.title: Apple Intelligence API: Restart Server
command.openConfig.title: Apple Intelligence API: Open Settings File
command.openPrompts.title: Apple Intelligence API: Open Prompt Settings
command.showLogs.title: Apple Intelligence API: Show Logs
command.showStatus.title: Apple Intelligence API: Show Status
command.resetDefaults.title: Apple Intelligence API: Reset Settings and Prompts to Defaults
configuration.title: Apple Intelligence API
configuration.enabled.description: Enable the local API server. When disabled, the process is terminated to free memory.
configuration.inline.instructions.markdo: Instruction prompt for inline completion. Used when no language-specific setting exists.
configuration.inline.languageInstruction: Per-language-ID inline instruction prompts. Fully replaces the default instructions for matching languages.
configuration.inline.promptTemplate.mark: Inline input template. Specify `{before}` and `{after}` exactly once each.
configuration.inline.languagePromptTempl: Per-language-ID inline input templates. Fully replaces the default template for matching languages.
configuration.nes.instructions.markdownD: Instruction prompt for NES. Used when no language-specific setting exists.
configuration.nes.languageInstructions.m: Per-language-ID NES instruction prompts. Fully replaces the default instructions for matching languages.
configuration.nes.promptTemplate.markdow: NES input template. Specify `{recentEdits}`, `{beforeTarget}`, `{afterTarget}`, and `{target}` exactly once each.
configuration.nes.languagePromptTemplate: Per-language-ID NES input templates. Fully replaces the default template for matching languages.
configuration.nes.renameHintTemplate.mar: Template for passing the latest rename to NES. Specify `{old}` and `{new}` exactly once each.
configuration.nes.languageRenameHintTemp: Per-language-ID rename templates. Fully replaces the default template for matching languages.
